hardware: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 8GB, GDM stopped

ngl_99_vs_15.finding: Full GPU offload (ngl 99) works on build 84e76d8+ with unified memory and is ~3x faster than the old hybrid guidance of ngl 15

key_findings.kv_location: At ngl 99 the KV cache lives on GPU (CUDA0). At ngl 15 it fell back to CPU (CUDA_Host) - the reason the old config was slow.

under_load_oom.config: 64k profile (65536 q8_0 ngl99), Hermes gateway resident
under_load_oom.event: kernel OOM-killed llama-server when the tool-call smoke test ran right after a 29K-token deep-gen filled the KV; journal: 'Out of memory: Killed process 488285 (llama-server) ... anon-rss:5206480kB ... task_memcg=hermes-gateway.service'
under_load_oom.lesson: 64k is fine standalone (gateway stopped); with the Hermes gateway resident use the 49k profile - 49152 q8_0 measured 4.72GB RSS with 1.16GB free after generation

failed_configs.131072_q8_0: CPU KV 3536 MiB + compute - allocation failure
failed_configs.81920_q8_0: failed compute pp buffers even with clean memory and drop_caches - q8_0 KV ceiling is 64K

deep_context_128k.note: q4_0 KV costs generation speed at depth; pp remains strong. 128K is for huge prompts, not long generations.

32k.use: fastest, full-precision KV, best for tool calling

49k.use: deep-load safe - use when the Hermes gateway is resident

64k.use: balanced default - 2x context for ~2% speed loss

128k.use: full native context for huge prompts; tightest margins - launch first, nothing else running

launch_command_template.sampling_tool_calling: temp 0.0 top_p 1.0 top_k 0 per request (greedy; IBM recommendation; BFCL v2 champion 96.2%)

test_notes.preflight: GDM stopped; MemAvailable >4.5GB before launch; pkill stale servers; poll /props not /health
test_notes.max_tokens_guidance: Keep prompt+response within profile ctx; for the 128K profile budget max_tokens <= 16384 so a long generation does not overflow the window
test_notes.reliability: Hybrid at ngl99 releases memory cleanly after pkill (no GPU-fragmentation lock like dense Ornith Q4_K_M) - retested across 8 launches, zero fragment failures

granite4_3b_rebench.verdict: no conv-accel gain for SSM conv1d (CUDA conv work targets conv2d/3d vision kernels); speed unchanged; ngl 99 still works; 64k still OOMs under deep-fill + followup request - 49k profile remains the agent config

llama_cpp_build_note.granite_4_2_8b: see granite42_8b_benchmark_20261001.md - dense 8B, IQ3_M only viable quant, 16K q4_0, 9.6 tok/s, enable_thinking:false required for tool calls
